abstract: Broadcasting is a team effort. It takes a village to produce great shows, and the leader of said village needs to be confident, organized, and knowledgeable. Trupti is one of those great leaders. With more than 20 years of industry experience, Trupti has worked with some of the most talented people in the media tech industry, and she's not done yet.
